screens.title: Feature details

screens.title: Secure device pairing
screens.ui_api_note: Prohibit unsigned capability ingestion; bind to child and authenticated device.

screens.title: Before permissions
screens.ui_api_note: Show purpose, required/optional, retention and who receives data before OS dialog.

screens.title: Location while using
screens.ui_api_note: For Android 11+ never request foreground and background location in one request.

screens.title: Background location
screens.ui_api_note: Android 11+ background location guided through settings; do not claim active until policy approved.

screens.title: Monitoring notifications
screens.ui_api_note: Do not hide icon/system indicators; notification permission denial impacts transparency.

screens.title: Usage access
screens.ui_api_note: Use UsageStatsManager permission state via AppOps; Android Settings, OS confirmation.

screens.title: Choose media access
screens.ui_api_note: READ_MEDIA_* with selected-photo access; never infer all library files from partial grant.

screens.title: Microphone permission
screens.ui_api_note: Do not solicit dangerous permission in commercial build unless released; use demo only.

screens.title: Camera access · Research
screens.ui_api_note: Never auto-enable media merely because hardware exists. Demo shown as research-only.

screens.title: Managed-device mode
screens.ui_api_note: Real device-owner enrollment may require factory reset; never claim admin equals owner.

screens.title: Screen-sharing consent
screens.ui_api_note: Android 14+ per-session MediaProjection token; do not store consent for reuse.

screens.title: Android decision received
screens.ui_api_note: ActivityResult then PackageManager/AppOps; never trust button-click or app-owned approval.

screens.title: Permission declined
screens.ui_api_note: Handle don't-ask-again/Settings flow without harassment or bypass.

screens.title: Selected photos only
screens.ui_api_note: Persist only allowed URI grants; never equate selected media with full library.

screens.title: Permission confirmed
screens.ui_api_note: Local OS grant, server durable ACK and parent confirmation are distinct events.

screens.title: Setup complete
screens.ui_api_note: Only permitted background components continue; main Alarka Activity need not remain open.

screens.title: Access changed in Settings
screens.ui_api_note: Revocation can terminate app process: cannot guarantee immediate callback or push.

screens.title: Re-enable a permission
screens.ui_api_note: A regrant updates permission state only; runtime operational and release gates separate.

screens.title: Offline changes queued
screens.ui_api_note: No claims of instant revocation propagation; deadlines and monotonic versions.

screens.title: Your monitoring controls
screens.ui_api_note: Visible identity and accessible privacy controls even after setup Activity normally closes.

screens.title: Child device connecting
screens.ui_api_note: First parent frame before trusted pairing/attestation. No parental spoofed capability.

screens.title: Device overview
screens.ui_api_note: Multiple counts should be derived separately, without conflating support/grant/active.

screens.title: Feature compatibility
screens.ui_api_note: Never use a single green feature flag for OS grants and runtime eligibility.

screens.title: Setup progress
screens.ui_api_note: Server stores versioned state, emits parent update on durable write.

screens.title: Access granted
screens.ui_api_note: Do not call all dependent features fully operational based on an OS grant.

screens.title: Permission disabled
screens.ui_api_note: Only a device-authenticated report justifies exact revocation claim; stop stream.

screens.title: Denied or unsupported?
screens.ui_api_note: Do not suggest bypass for legal feature-off or absent hardware.

screens.title: Temporary access
screens.ui_api_note: One-time camera/mic/location grants can terminate; TTL and capture-time check required.

screens.title: Partial media access
screens.ui_api_note: No arbitrary filesystem access or inference of selected photo selection list.

screens.title: Remote camera conditions
screens.ui_api_note: Permission green but media operational amber / release flag OFF.

screens.title: Screen request approval
screens.ui_api_note: No repeated media projection token reuse; do not promise remote activation.

screens.title: Managed-mode requirement
screens.ui_api_note: Device Admin access alone does not create device-owner authority.

screens.title: Alarka is offline
screens.ui_api_note: No fabricated 'permission revoked' result from stale/offline snapshot.

screens.title: Status needs recheck
screens.ui_api_note: Per-feature TTL; stale not green; recheck at command execution.

screens.title: Status restored
screens.ui_api_note: Server broadcasts only after durable write and monotonic version validation.

screens.title: Permission change history
screens.ui_api_note: Change audit reason/actor/source with limited retention; no raw media or protected data.

screens.title: How to enable location
screens.ui_api_note: No parent-side silent permission grant; preserve Android user agency.

screens.title: Guardian access check
screens.ui_api_note: Authorization for report reading and permission-related commands must be child-specific.

screens.title: Report version conflict
screens.ui_api_note: Monotonic version + compare-and-set; reject duplicates/conflicts and require device-signed source.

screens.title: Privacy switch disabled
screens.ui_api_note: Do not override global sensor controls; report exact reason only with actual device evidence.

screens.title: Approval reversed
screens.ui_api_note: Revocation may kill process; event can only appear after subsequent authenticated sync.

screens.title: Full compatibility details
screens.ui_api_note: Green operational only if supported + proper access + context + release approved + fresh confirmation.

screens.title: Media activity
screens.ui_api_note: Parent shows only authorized children; default last 7 days; server cursor pagination, no server media file links.

screens.title: Choose a child

screens.title: Date range
screens.ui_api_note: Timezone localized, to-exclusive UTC server boundary; reject reversed/oversized/retention-exceeding queries.

screens.title: Filter results

screens.title: Session details

screens.title: Saved recording details
screens.ui_api_note: Historical receipt cannot prove parent file remains after deletion; do not provide server download links.

screens.title: Why did it fail?
screens.ui_api_note: Show exact OS error only when verified. Phone call/mic-used attribution cannot be invented.

screens.title: No matching activity
screens.ui_api_note: Empty is distinct from unauthorized, failed server request, and offline device.

screens.title: Historical activity offline
screens.ui_api_note: Read-only history does not wake child. Never infer a sensor-specific failure from an offline phone.

screens.title: Browse more activity
screens.ui_api_note: Stable sort (request_at DESC, ID DESC) and signed cursors with previous/next; no duplicate rows on changes.

screens.title: Access not available
screens.ui_api_note: No cross-family ID enumeration and expired guardian grants invalidate cached pages.

screens.title: Administrator sign-in
screens.ui_api_note: Separate admin JWT audience, MFA, short TTL, server-side role and case. No media log data before sign-in.

screens.title: Operations overview
screens.ui_api_note: No named children in routine support dashboard. Hide aggregate when small-number inference risky.

screens.title: Request case-based access
screens.ui_api_note: Case/purpose scope server-issued, expiring; ordinary operator role cannot grant itself universal search.

screens.title: Media activity explorer

screens.title: Search parent accounts
screens.ui_api_note: Name/ID autocomplete debounced and server-scope filtered; lookup itself recorded in access audit.

screens.title: Search children
screens.ui_api_note: Child parent relationship validated server-side; dropdown may not reveal siblings outside explicit case.

screens.title: Media record details
screens.ui_api_note: Admin cannot replay, download, thumbnail or access media; viewed requires parent display/playback receipt.

screens.title: Failure reason & evidence
screens.ui_api_note: No raw exception texts or third-party call data. Distinguish verified reason source from unknown context.

screens.title: No results or no access
screens.ui_api_note: UI distinguishes zero result/403/401/422/429, no identity leaks in error or suggestions.

screens.title: Pagination and retry
screens.ui_api_note: Keyset cursor with previous/next history, bounded page size max 100, cancellation and retry; scope checked every page.

screens.title: Administrator access audit
screens.ui_api_note: Search, suggestions, detail reads and export attempts write audit; fail closed if audit not persisted.

screens.title: Privacy and retention gates
screens.ui_api_note: Privacy-approved retention TTLs TBD; operator read-only unless separate signed change; backup/deletion protection.

screens.title: Session expired
screens.ui_api_note: 401 and session expiry require step-up; no cached child rows displayed on expired screen.

screens.title: Access denied
screens.ui_api_note: 403 must not reveal existence of target parent/child. Audit failed attempt. No admin superuser default bypass.

screens.title: Controlled export request
screens.ui_api_note: Download/export disabled by default, requires case-bound dual control, audit and DLP review.

screens.title: Role and case assignment
screens.ui_api_note: Manage role grants via separate governed workflow; root does not automatically receive child metadata rights.

screens.title: Audit service unavailable
screens.ui_api_note: Fail closed for detailed access if independent admin-access audit cannot durably append.
